title: Delivery Channels

aliyun_directmail.name: Alibaba Cloud DirectMail
aliyun_directmail.tagline: Each workspace uses its own Alibaba Cloud account and verified sender domain.
aliyun_directmail.trackingFieldHelp: Create this tag in your DirectMail console first. Letters, digits, and underscores only.
aliyun_directmail.trackingDesc: When enabled, new emails track opens and clicks. Past campaigns are unaffected.
aliyun_directmail.webhookDesc: Receives delivery, complaint, unsubscribe, and engagement events. Disconnecting the channel does not auto-disable receipts.
aliyun_directmail.webhookTokenGuide: Enter this as the Token in EventBridge HTTP target advanced settings; header name is x-eventbridge-signature-token.
aliyun_directmail.secretHelp: Visible only while entering — never shown in plaintext after saving.

amazon_ses.name: Amazon SES
amazon_ses.tagline: Each workspace uses its own AWS account and verified SES identity.
amazon_ses.sandboxNotice: New SES accounts start in sandbox mode (~200 emails/day, 1/sec, verified recipients only). Request production access from AWS; sandbox limits are not a configuration error.
amazon_ses.trackingFieldHelp: Create this Configuration Set in the SES console with event publishing enabled. Letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens only.
amazon_ses.trackingDesc: When enabled, new emails track opens and clicks via your SES Configuration Set. Past campaigns are unaffected.
amazon_ses.webhookDesc: Receives SES events via Amazon SNS. The first subscription notification is confirmed automatically.
amazon_ses.webhookTokenGuide: Pass this token via query parameter token= or header x-edm-webhook-token in your SNS HTTPS subscription.
amazon_ses.secretHelp: Visible only while entering — never shown in plaintext after saving.

sendgrid.name: SendGrid
sendgrid.tagline: Each workspace uses its own SendGrid account and authenticated sender domain.
sendgrid.sandboxNotice: SendGrid requires Domain Authentication and Signed Event Webhook; your API Key must include Mail Send permission.
sendgrid.trackingFieldHelp: SendGrid toggles open/click tracking directly in Mail Send requests — no extra field required.
sendgrid.trackingDesc: When enabled, new emails track opens and clicks via SendGrid. Past campaigns are unaffected.
sendgrid.webhookDesc: Enable Signed Event Webhook in SendGrid, point the HTTPS URL above, and save the verification public key.
sendgrid.webhookTokenGuide: Include token= in the webhook URL or pass it in the x-edm-webhook-token header.
sendgrid.secretHelp: API Key must have Mail Send permission.

intro.title: Connect your first delivery channel
intro.subtitle: Prepare the three items below. Once saved, you can send a test email to the current Admin's inbox.
intro.senderBody: A verified sender address and domain from your provider console, plus the From name recipients see.
intro.regionBody: Must match the region where your sender identity is verified.
intro.credentialBody: A dedicated AccessKey or API Key with send permission from your provider console.
intro.footnote: From name appears in the inbox header; set your Sign-off name in My Sign-off and your footer contact address in Store Details.

readOnlyNotice: You have read-only access. Ask a workspace Admin to connect, update, or test delivery channels.
credentialKeyringUnavailableTitle: Cannot save channel credentials right now
credentialKeyringUnavailableBody: Server credential encryption is not configured yet. Ask your deployment admin to check the EDM credential keyring before connecting or updating channels.

nextStep.title: Primary channel verified — continue send readiness
nextStep.description: Tests only verify the channel. Formal sends also check sender identity, footer address, contact consent, list eligibility, and plan limits.

unconnected.title: Not connected yet
unconnected.detail: Prepare your sender identity, region, and access credentials to connect.

disconnected.title: Channel disconnected
disconnected.detail: Saved credentials have been removed. Reconnect and send a test email before using this channel again.

incomplete.title: Configuration incomplete
incomplete.detail: Update your sender identity and full credentials, then send a test email to verify.

testPending.title: Test in progress
testPending.detail: Refresh the test result before changing settings or retrying to avoid duplicate sends.

testUnknown.title: Check your last test first
testUnknown.detail: The previous test result was inconclusive and may have been sent. Check your inbox and provider console before retesting.

verified.title: Channel verified
verified.detail: Your provider accepted the test email. Check the Admin inbox (including spam) and provider logs.

error.title: Channel needs attention
error.detail: Review the latest test error and recovery guidance below, fix your settings, and test again.

configured.title: Saved — send a test email next
configured.detail: Saving doesn't verify connectivity yet. Send a test email to confirm credentials, region, and sender identity.

testResult.heading: Latest test: {status}
testResult.historicalNotice: This test was run on an earlier configuration and does not verify the current settings.

pending.title: Queued
pending.detail: Test recorded and awaiting provider response. Refresh manually rather than submitting again.

processing.title: Processing
processing.detail: Test is being processed. Refresh manually; closing this page won't cancel the request.

accepted.title: Accepted by provider
accepted.detail: Accepted means the provider received the send request — not that it landed in the inbox or was read.

failed.title: Send failed
failed.detail: Review the guidance below, fix the issue, and send another test.

unknown.title: Result unknown
unknown.detail: The email may have been sent. Check the Admin inbox and provider console before retrying to avoid duplicates.

detail.testRecipientNote: Test recipient: {recipient}. Test emails go only to the current Admin, never to your contacts.
detail.testPendingNotice: A test is still in progress. Refresh its result before editing settings or starting another action.
detail.submittingTestNotice: Submitting test email to your provider. Keep this page open.
detail.testErrorGuidance: Check your inbox and provider console first. Resuming reuses the same request key; if the last request never reached the server, one email may still be sent.
detail.retestConfirmTitle: Send a new test after checking?
detail.retestConfirmDescription: The last result was unknown and an email may already have been sent. Check the Admin inbox and provider console first — continuing uses a new request key and may send another email.
detail.unconfiguredTitle: This delivery channel is not configured yet.
detail.unconfiguredDescription: Save your region, verified sender identity, and dedicated credentials to test sending.
detail.credentialEncrypted: Credentials are encrypted at rest and never shown in plaintext.
detail.credentialMissing: No sending credentials are saved on this channel yet.
detail.keyringReadOnlyAlert: Credential encryption key is not configured on the server; channels are currently read-only.
detail.adminOnlyNotice: Only Admins can connect or modify delivery channels.
detail.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this delivery channel? Saved encrypted credentials will be deleted.
detail.disconnectNote: Disconnecting removes saved credentials without disabling delivery webhooks.

webhook.heading: Delivery receipt Webhook
webhook.tokenOnceNotice: Save this token now — it is shown only once
webhook.eventBridgeHelp: Choose event source acs.dm and Full Event payload (not acs.directmail). Enable retries in Alibaba Cloud console.
webhook.sesHint: Enable SNS event publishing in your SES Configuration Set and point an HTTPS subscription to the URL above. Match the Topic ARN in channel settings; confirmation is automatic.
webhook.sendgridHint: Save the Signed Event Webhook public key from SendGrid in channel settings, or incoming receipts will be rejected.
webhook.revokeConfirm: Disable delivery webhook? Future provider events will be rejected.
webhook.directmailGraceHint: After rotation, the previous token stays valid for 15 minutes for zero-downtime EventBridge updates.

tracking.heading: Open & click tracking
tracking.unsupported: {provider} does not support open or click tracking.
tracking.toggleHint: Tracks email opens and link clicks. Privacy features like Apple Mail Privacy Protection may affect open rates.
tracking.missingTagHint: Enter a tracking tag or Configuration Set name first

dialog.description: Save your sender identity and credentials first, then send a test email to the current Admin. Saving does not verify the channel.
dialog.identityHelp: Verify your sender identity in your provider console first, then enter the exact details below.
dialog.senderAliasHelp: Shown as the sender name in recipients' inbox (up to {max} chars).
dialog.senderAddressHelpWithDomain: Must belong to the sender domain below and be verified in your provider console.
dialog.senderAddressHelpNoDomain: Use a sender identity verified in your provider console.
dialog.senderDomainHelp: Enter your verified domain without https:// or paths.
dialog.replyToHelp: Used when recipients reply; leave blank to use the sender address.
dialog.signatureNotePrefix: From name is separate from your email body sign-off. To edit your sign-off,
dialog.signatureNoteSuffix: ; set your footer contact address under Store Details.
dialog.regionHelp: Must match the region of your verified sender identity; the default selection is not auto-verified.
dialog.credentialsHelpRequired: Obtain dedicated credentials with send permission from your provider console.
dialog.credentialsHelpOptional: Existing credentials are saved securely. Leave blank to keep them, or enter full new credentials to replace.
dialog.snsTopicHelp: Fill before configuring receipts; the Topic region must match the AWS region above.
dialog.publicKeyHelp: Required before enabling Signed Event Webhook in SendGrid.
dialog.saveErrorGuidance: Your input is preserved here — review and try saving again. If there is a version conflict, close and reopen to load the latest config.
dialog.statusSubmitting: Saving configuration — keep this page open.
dialog.statusClean: Send a test email after saving to verify
dialog.saveUnconfirmedError: Could not confirm save. Your input was preserved — check channel status and try again.

toast.copyFailed: Failed to copy {label}. Please copy manually.
toast.savedNeedTest: Configuration saved — send a test email next
toast.saveRequestIncomplete: Save request did not complete. Check your connection and channel status, then try again.
toast.operationUnconfirmed: Could not confirm the operation result. Refresh to check current status before retrying.
toast.disconnected: Delivery channel disconnected and credentials removed
toast.testMismatch: Test result did not match this channel. Refresh to check.
toast.testUnknown: Send result unknown — check your inbox and provider console first
toast.testInterrupted: Request interrupted — unable to confirm send result.
toast.testNoRecord: No test record found yet — check your inbox and provider console
